exposure: Disrespect and abuse during labour and birth (lack of choices, lack of communication, lack of support, harsh or rough treatment/physical violence)
Respondent characteristics (age, ethnicity, educational level, parity)
outcome: Frequency of experiencing disrespect and abuse during labour and birth
cohort: A national sample of 12,239 women in the Netherlands who gave birth up to five years prior to the survey.
finding: Disrespectful and abusive experiences during labour and birth are regularly reported in the Netherlands, are often experienced as upsetting, and are associated with a more negative birth experience, especially among primiparous women and those with a migrant background.
cross-section timing: Post-birth, recalling experiences up to five years prior
